base_member_text: [L217-L234,L1687-L1704,L2173-L2195] (MED/buffer-extent-contract) Caller-supplied count and map are forwarded without checking that their memory footprint fits values or defaultIntArray, permitting out-of-bounds transfers for inconsistent selections.
audit_member_text: [L223-L234,L2184-L2195,L3156-L3167] (MED/buffer-capacity) Explicit counts and memory maps are forwarded without validating their addressed span against values or defaultIntArray, permitting file-valid selections that exceed the supplied storage.

adversarial.rationale: The missing capacity checks are real, but this is a caller-supplied memory-selection violation, not an overflow caused by the default selection: shape(values) supplies the default counts and all trailing counts are one (netcdf_expanded.f90:215-218). Retain as a LOW defensive-validation issue for explicit count/map combinations whose addressed memory footprint exceeds the actual buffer; the legacy external interface cannot see that buffer extent.

neutralizer.quote:
numDims                 = size(shape(values))

     localCount (:numDims  ) = shape(values)
     localCount (numDims+1:) = 1
     localStride(:         ) = 1
     localMap   (:numDims  ) = (/ 1, (product(localCount(:counter)), counter = 1, numDims - 1) /)

base_member_text: [L2173-L2197,L2432-L2456] (MED/uninitialized-read) Integer array getters reshape the entire uninitialized temporary after partial, sparse, zero-count, or failed reads, evaluating elements the underlying call did not populate.
[L141-L149,L159-L167] (LOW/error-path-output) Scalar integer getters assign defaultInteger to values even when the underlying read fails without defining the temporary.
audit_member_text: [L142-L149,L160-L167,L2173-L2197,L2654-L2678] (MED/uninitialized-read) Integer getters copy their entire uninitialized temporary after errors, partial-count reads or mapped reads with holes, including entries the backend never wrote.

adversarial.rationale: The FourByteInt and EightByteInt getters allocate automatic defaultIntArray(size(values)) without initialization, then unconditionally reshape the entire array after every backend branch (netcdf_expanded.f90:2164-2198,2645-2679). A successful read with count=(/1/) into a larger values array already leaves an unwritten tail, so neither error handling nor backend file-bound checks break the finding; the direct OneByteInt/TwoByteInt paths do not repair these overloads.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

audit_member_text: [L153-L167,L2423-L2456,L2645-L2678] (MED/numeric-range) EightByteInt reads go through default-integer temporaries, unnecessarily restricting values read from floating-point variables to the default integer range before widening them.

base_member_text: [L215-L228,L1685-L1698] (LOW/uninitialized-map-contract) localMap is initialized only through the memory-array rank, leaving trailing map entries undefined when a shorter supplied map is used with a higher-rank file variable.
audit_member_text: [L217-L228,L2181-L2189,L3150-L3161] (MED/uninitialized-map) Map entries above the values rank remain uninitialized when a partial map is supplied, yet explicit counts can activate those additional file dimensions with counts greater than one.

adversarial.rationale: localMap is automatic storage and only entries through the values rank are initialized; present(map) overwrites only its supplied prefix (netcdf_expanded.f90:211-228). The default trailing count of one is a partial protection, but the claim explicitly activates extra dimensions using count greater than one, and neither module initialization nor an external interface supplies the missing map entries.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L55-L67,L939-L1181] (MED/integer-narrowing) Every EightByteInt put wrapper converts values to default INTEGER before netCDF sees them, allowing out-of-range 64-bit values to be corrupted without a netCDF range error.
audit_member_text: [L55-L67,L939-L969,L1149-L1179] (HIGH/numeric-narrowing) Every EightByteInt write converts values to default integer before netCDF sees them, silently losing out-of-range bits and preventing the backend from reporting the original value's range error.

adversarial.rationale: Every EightByteInt scalar/array write reaches nf_put_var*_int with int(values), including all three array dispatch branches (netcdf_expanded.f90:55-68,939-971,1149-1181). With the bundled ordinary default-integer build, a value such as 4294967296 is narrowed before backend conversion even when a netCDF double variable could represent it; typeSizes.f90:36 selects the input kind but provides no range guard or wider conversion path.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check
